query: For my 89-year-old male patient: among hospitalized men aged 84–94, what is the maximum single inpatient DAPT prescription duration?
final_sql: SELECT MAX(p.stoptime - p.starttime) AS max_duration FROM prescriptions p JOIN patients pt ON p.subject_id = pt.subject_id JOIN admissions a ON p.hadm_id = a.hadm_id WHERE pt.gender = 'M' AND pt.anchor_age = 89 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2015 AND p.drug_type = 'DAPT';
